name: events
description: Upcoming San Francisco Rec & Park events & programming (parks, plazas, rec centers). Filter by date window and keyword (title/location/description). Free/outdoor/community civic events.

to.description: Latest event date YYYY-MM-DD (default: no upper bound).

query.description: Keyword over title, location, and description, e.g. "yoga", "Golden Gate", "kids".
